text: まるくて　もちやすいので　つかんで　あいてに　なげて　ぶつける　イシツブテ　がっせんが　できる。

structure.jp: まるくて　もちやすいので
structure.en: because it is round and easy to hold

structure.jp: つかんで　あいてに　なげて　ぶつける
structure.en: grabbing it, throwing it at the other person and hitting them

structure.jp: イシツブテ　がっせんが

patterns.name: 〜ので
patterns.explanation: ので after a statement gives the reason for what comes next. もちやすいので = 'because it is easy to hold'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: つかんで　あいてに　なげて　ぶつける　イシツブテ　がっせん
patterns.explanation: A whole phrase ending in a verb sits in front of a thing and tells you what kind of thing it is. つかんで　あいてに　なげて　ぶつける　イシツブテ　がっせん = 'a Geodude fight where you grab them and throw them at each other'.

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb means 'easy to do'. もちやすい = 'easy to hold'.
